description.subtitle: Barcelona Nike Drawstring Backpack - Navy
description.tagline: Represent FCB in comfort and style
description.intro: The Nike Barcelona Academy drawstring backpack is the perfect option to transport your equipment lightly on a daily basis. Inspired by the Catalan club, it combines a sporty design with the practicality you need for your training or travel.
key_benefits: Lightweight design: Perfect for carrying essentials without adding extra weight.
Quick access: Lace-up closure system that makes it easy to open and close in seconds.
Official Barcelona style: Show your passion for FCB in every training session.
Versatile use: Ideal for gym, workouts or everyday use.
